title: STEINERT KSS CLI product page
scope: Commercial color + 3D + induction for PCB/stainless/cable concentrates; no independent Ferrosift-feed benchmark.

title: MSS MetalMiner product page
scope: Commercial coil-based detection and individually controlled air ejection, including e-scrap. Vendor performance claims are not transferred.

title: STEINERT ISS product page
scope: Acceleration belt presents settled material; application-specific ejection arrangements.

title: Pepperl+Fuchs inductive operating distance
scope: Target material and dimensions affect proximity-sensor range; standard target specifications are conditional. Illustrates physics; not a selected sorter array.

title: Micro-Epsilon eddyNCDT 306x/307x manual
scope: Installation/metal surroundings and target-size calibration requirements, especially sections 4.2 and 4.7. Displacement sensor, not proven scrap composition sensor.

title: Micro-Epsilon eddyNCDT technical catalog
scope: Influence of material, target thickness, tilt and geometry; model-specific calibration. Not a recipe for measuring metal mass in PCBs.

title: Micro-Epsilon eddyNCDT 3020 setup instructions
scope: Adjacent probes can interact; spacing or frequency separation is needed. These specific probes have cable-length constraints.

title: Basler line-scan GigE use cases
scope: Synchronize line acquisition to belt travel with encoder input; trigger configuration depends on camera.

title: Basler acquisition timing information
scope: Exposure-start delays, input delay and acquisition timing depend on model/settings; total image-to-output latency must be measured.

title: Basler acA2440-75uc product specifications
scope: Global-shutter color, 2448 x 2048 default pixels, nominal 75 fps, C-mount, USB3, body 29.3 x 29 x 29 mm. Candidate only; verify lifecycle and interfaces before selection.

title: CCS HLDL3 lighting series
scope: Bar lights with adjustable brackets, diffusion and polarizing options; physical light length is not guaranteed uniform field coverage.

title: LMI Gocator 2300 series
scope: 2380 FOV varies from 390 to 1260 mm over measurement volume; 350 mm clearance and 800 mm measurement range. Check actual working plane and optical model.

title: SICK conveyor encoder application
scope: Drive/roller sensing does not observe belt slip; measuring-wheel approach measures actual belt motion. Wheel contamination and item slip still need testing.

title: SICK DFS60I-S4WC65536 datasheet
scope: Example encoder mechanical/electrical integration and 200 mm circumference measuring-wheel accessory; exact suffix must be selected.

title: SMC SX10 high-speed valve catalog
scope: Variant-dependent response, flow, power and pressure; 9 mm body and >=9.5 mm mounting pitch; response values are vendor test values, not guaranteed complete-system timing.

title: SMC SX10 operation manual
scope: Clean unlubricated air, filtration, driver duty/heat and safe servicing restrictions; use qualified pneumatic/electrical engineering.

title: OSHA 1910.212 general machine guarding
scope: Guarding of nip points, rotating parts and flying material. Jurisdiction/applicability and design compliance are not determined here.

title: OSHA 1910.147 hazardous energy
scope: Servicing requires appropriate hazardous-energy isolation, stored-energy treatment and verification; not a certification.

title: HSE waste sorting and WEEE hazards
scope: WEEE hazardous substances, batteries/fire, noise, handling and hygiene. UK guidance is a review input, not worldwide compliance evidence.

title: OSHA combustible dust technical manual
scope: Dust hazard depends on actual material; compressed-air cleanup can disperse dust. Review handling, collection and ignition control.

title: OSHA lithium-ion battery safety controls
scope: Battery damage/fire prevention and handling controls; baseline sorter is not validated battery detection.

title: HSE machinery safety in waste
scope: Equipment risk, maintenance, isolation, entanglement and access review.

title: TOMRA AUTOSORT PULSE product page
scope: Commercial LIBS alloy/grade sorting with object handling and bulk feed. Different sensing mechanism/feed; vendor rates are not comparable performance evidence.
